items.name: sampling/createMessage
items.summary: Ask the host to run an LLM completion. Returns the host result dict.
items.signature: create_message(*, messages: List[dict], max_tokens: int, system_prompt: Optional[str] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, stop_sequences: Optional[List[str]] = None, model_preferences: Optional[dict] = None, include_context: str = 'none', metadata: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: float = 90.0) -> dict

params.name: max_tokens
params.desc: Required; per-call cap (host enforces hard upper bound).

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Optional sampling temperature. Host substitutes ``0.7`` when ``None`` — it does **not** defer to the provider default.

params.name: model_preferences
params.desc: MCP-style ``{"hints":[{"name":"..."}], "costPriority":0..1, "speedPriority":..., "intelligencePriority":...}``. Omit (None) to let the host fall back to the user's saved ``preferred_model``.

params.name: include_context
params.desc: Reserved. Phase 1 requires ``"none"``; any other value is rejected with ``SAMPLING_ERR_INVALID_REQUEST``.

params.name: metadata
params.desc: **Reserved / not yet consumed by host.** Forwarded on the wire but currently dropped by the Nexus gate (no audit, no logging, no propagation to token-usage records). Do not rely on it for tracing until host support lands.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Client-side wall-clock seconds before raising ``asyncio.TimeoutError``. Also propagated to the host on the wire as ``_clientTimeoutS`` so that matrix-agent (HTTP) and nexus-gate (ChatOpenAI ``timeout`` + ``asyncio.wait_for``) can cap their own deadlines inside this budget — preventing a "ghost success" where the host completes and bills after the client has already given up. Host clamps the derived model budget to ``[30s, 300s]``.

returns.desc: MCP-shaped sampling result, e.g. `{role, content:{type:'text', text}, model, stopReason}`.

errors.name: SAMPLING_ERR_NOT_NEGOTIATED
errors.desc: v2 handshake never advertised sampling capability.

errors.name: SAMPLING_ERR_TIMEOUT
errors.desc: Raised either client-side (SDK `timeout` elapsed before host replied) or server-side (nexus gate's model-call budget — derived from `_clientTimeoutS - 15s`, clamped to `[30s, 300s]` — exceeded). HTTP mapping: 504.

errors.name: SAMPLING_ERR_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: Upstream LLM provider returned an error.

errors.name: SAMPLING_ERR_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: Host did not authorize sampling for this invoke.

items.example:
from executa_sdk.sampling import SamplingClient

sampler = SamplingClient()

reply = await sampler.create_message(
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": {"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}}],
    max_tokens=256,
    system_prompt="You are concise.",
    model_preferences={"hints": [{"name": "claude-3-5-sonnet"}]},
    timeout=60.0,
)
print(reply["content"]["text"])
